text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Clear intro, body, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay follows a more recognizable structure with an introduction, supporting paragraphs, and a closing statement."},{"evidence":"“To begin with,” “Next,” “Finally,” “In conclusion”","quality":"transitions","description":"The essay uses explicit linking words to guide the reader through its points."},{"evidence":"Separate paragraphs for talents, skills, and favorites","quality":"coherence","description":"Ideas are grouped and sequenced more clearly, making the writing easier to follow."},{"evidence":"“my talent is roaring like a lion… My other talent is hoola-hooping… My final talent is drawing”","quality":"enumeration of details","description":"The essay gives multiple concrete examples to support its main idea."},{"evidence":"“I enjoy drawing because i can draw what i'm feeling”","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"It adds some explanation of personal meaning rather than only naming items."},{"evidence":"“I use my arms and legs… i would need a lot of energy for it”","quality":"specific description","description":"The essay includes more concrete action-based descriptions of skills and how they are done."}]}
